You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 31 of 50 (script duration 160.0 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E21: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
E22: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
E23: After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.
E24: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
E25: Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
E26: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.
E27: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
E28: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.
E29: Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.
E30: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
Direct lead-in to E31: Follows directly from Episode 30 where Rupert and Catherine plotted to frame Juliana as a witch while Juliana huddled chained in the subterranean dungeon.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-2.8] SCREEN: Static medium shot of the heavy, iron-studded dungeon door as the massive bolt loudly slides open.
[L002 0.0-2.8] SFX: Heavy iron latch sliding back with an ominous, echoing metallic clang, followed by the deep groaning creak of the cell door swinging inward.
[L003 2.8-4.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana huddled against the stone wall, bound in heavy iron chains, shivering in her torn apron and lifting her tear-streaked face in dread.
[L004 2.8-4.2] ACTION: Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.
[L005 4.2-9.5] SCREEN: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.
[L006 6.9-8.8] CATHERINE (Cruel, Condescending): "Look at you."
[L007 9.5-10.5] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
[L008 10.5-13.8] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.
[L009 10.5-13.8] CATHERINE (Mocking, Venomous): "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
[L010 13.8-17.6] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.
[L011 14.0-17.6] CATHERINE (Taunting): "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
[L012 17.6-20.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.
[L013 17.8-20.5] JULIANA (Defiant, Steady): "You seem very pleased."
[L014 20.8-24.5] SCREEN: Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.
[L015 21.0-23.5] CATHERINE (Smug, Chilling): "I am."
[L016 24.5-29.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.
[L017 25.0-28.9] CATHERINE (Whispering, Sinister): "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
[L018 29.0-34.8] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.
[L019 29.3-34.8] CATHERINE (Scornful): "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
[L020 34.8-39.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.
[L021 35.0-38.9] CATHERINE (Amused, Spiteful): "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
[L022 39.0-43.0] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.
[L023 39.2-43.0] JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken): "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
[L024 43.0-48.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.
[L025 43.2-48.5] CATHERINE (Cold, Bitter): "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
[L026 48.5-54.8] SCREEN: Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
[L027 48.9-50.8] CATHERINE (Gloating): "Do you remember?"
[L028 49.0-52.0] ACTION: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
[L029 51.0-54.8] CATHERINE (Viciously Delighted): "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
[L030 54.8-59.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
[L031 55.2-57.5] SFX: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
[L032 55.5-58.8] CATHERINE (Quietly Venomous): "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
[L033 59.0-65.5] SCREEN: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.
[L034 59.2-61.3] JULIANA (Proud, Measured): "Gerald chose money."
[L035 61.5-63.5] JULIANA (Resolute): "Clarissa chose a coward."
[L036 63.8-65.3] JULIANA (Unyielding): "I chose myself."
[L037 65.5-67.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.
[L038 65.6-67.4] CATHERINE (Disgusted): "You chose a beggar."
[L039 67.5-70.5] SCREEN: Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.
[L040 67.6-69.8] JULIANA (Fierce, Proud): "I chose a man."
[L041 70.5-73.3] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.
[L042 70.8-73.2] CATHERINE (Contemptuous): "A scarred nobody."
[L043 73.3-77.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.
[L044 73.5-77.6] JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified): "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."
[L045 77.6-80.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.
[L046 77.8-80.2] CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking): "You call that marriage?"
[L047 80.5-83.2] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.
[L048 80.8-83.2] JULIANA (Pure, Sincere): "I call it love."
[L049 83.2-88.0] SCREEN: High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.
[L050 83.5-87.4] CATHERINE (Mocking, Hysterical Laugh): "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
[L051 87.5-91.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.
[L052 87.8-91.2] JULIANA (Firm, Piercing): "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."
[L053 91.2-94.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.
[L054 91.4-94.2] CATHERINE (Incredulous, Offended): "You think love makes you better than me?"
[L055 94.2-98.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.
[L056 94.5-98.2] JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."
[L057 98.2-103.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.
[L058 98.5-103.3] CATHERINE (Incensed, Boastful): "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"
[L059 103.5-108.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.
[L060 103.7-108.5] JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful): "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."
[L061 108.8-110.5] SCREEN: Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.
[L062 110.2-111.4] CATHERINE (Sneering, Derisive): "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"
[L063 111.5-118.2] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.
[L064 111.6-118.2] CATHERINE (Arrogant, Elitist): "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."
[L065 118.2-122.5] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.
[L066 118.4-122.0] JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative): "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
[L067 122.0-124.0] ACTION: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
[L068 124.0-130.8] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.
[L069 124.2-130.5] JULIANA (Accusatory, Commanding): "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."
[L070 130.8-133.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.
[L071 131.0-132.8] CATHERINE (Enraged Scream): "Enough!"
[L072 133.0-134.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.
[L073 133.2-134.5] SFX: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
[L074 134.5-138.0] SCREEN: Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.
[L075 134.5-138.0] CATHERINE (Hateful, Malicious): "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
[L076 138.0-140.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
[L077 138.0-140.5] ACTION: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
[L078 138.4-140.4] JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping): "[gasping] Give it back!"
[L079 140.5-143.8] SCREEN: Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.
[L080 140.7-143.8] CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic): "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
[L081 143.8-145.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.
[L082 144.0-145.5] JULIANA (Screaming, Agonized): "No!"
[L083 145.5-151.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.
[L084 145.6-151.2] CATHERINE (Vicious, Final): "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."
[L085 151.2-155.2] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
[L086 151.5-155.2] ACTION: Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.
[L087 155.2-160.0] SCREEN: Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}

YOUR PREVIOUS ANSWER:
{"candidates": [{"title": "Dungeon Branding Iron Threat", "segments": [{"start_line": "L001", "end_line": "L002"}, {"start_line": "L151", "end_line": "L160"}], "hook_line": "L001", "hook": "The sound of a heavy dungeon bolt sliding open and the visual of a dark, oppressive cell instantly creates high stakes.", "hook_quote": "", "cliffhanger_line": "L160", "cliffhanger": "Will Catherine press the red-hot iron into Juliana's eye?", "cliffhanger_quote": "", "why_it_works": "It combines the immediate physical threat of a torture device with the high-tension environment of a dungeon.", "setup_needed": "none", "spoiler_risk": "low", "self_score": 9}]}

Some of your candidates broke the hard rules. Code computed these problems:
- "Dungeon Branding Iron Threat": unknown line id L151

Return the same JSON shape again with corrected versions of ONLY the rejected candidates (same titles). Fix the boundaries by choosing different line IDs; keep the idea if it is good. Remember: 20-60 s total, hook_line starts within the first 3 s, cliffhanger_line inside the promo near its end, quotes copied exactly. Set episode_summary to "".
